violation_type.title: Doors to Fenced Area Easily Opened By Children (26 TAC §746.5209(b))
violation_type.short_title: Doors to Fenced Area Easily Opened By Children
violation_type.typical_finding: During the walk through the emergency exit doors located in the both school age classroom, toddler classroom were the dead bolt was locked  and was unable to be unlocked except by a key. The pre-k classroom emergency door was dead lock was lock that did not require a key.     This was corrected at inspection when they were unlocked.

finding_variants.text: During the walk through the emergency exit doors located in the both school age classroom, toddler classroom were the dead bolt was locked  and was unable to be unlocked except by a key. The pre-k classroom emergency door was dead lock was lock that did not require a key.     This was corrected at inspection when they were unlocked.
An exterior door designated as an emergency exit in a classroom was unable to be opened during the inspection.
A classroom door leading into the fenced in playground does not open correctly from the inside or outside. The door gets stuck half way when you push or pull it open.
One of the exit doors in Building G was locked during business hours. This door functions as an exit during an emergency. This was corrected at inspection when the door was unlocked.
The exit door from the afterschool classroom to the toddler playground is broken at the bottom.
